sentences.text: This review covers wellbore 15/9-F-15 on the VOLVE field, an observation well whose Sodir status is P&A.
Its first report without a before-spud flag is dated 2008-11-10 and its last report 2018-01-24, a report span of 3363 days with 33 active days.
The 69 reports include 36 flagged as dated before spud, and they form 2 campaigns.
Sodir gives a total depth of 4105.0 m, and the deepest reported depth is 4090.0 m measured depth at a true vertical depth of 3178.0 m.

Total activity time is 1435.48 h, of which primary lost time is 74.0 h, or 5.16% of activity time; possible lost time of 157.0 h (10.94%) is reported separately and is not included in the primary figure.

The main outcome: the hole was drilled from a 36.0 in section to an 8.5 in section, reaching 4090.0 m MD in section 6, and was then plugged back with cement plugs, a mechanical plug and a casing cut before plug and abandonment.
The largest lost-time item was well control in section 6, with 49.0 h of primary time from circulation losses that needed repeated LCM pills.
Campaign 1 runs from 2008-11-10 to 2008-12-11, a span of 32.0 days with 32 active days and a dominant operation phase of drilling.
Campaign 2 is a single day, 2018-01-24, with 1 active day and no recorded operation phase; its report has no recorded activities.

Sodir gives the completion date as 2008-12-05, the end of drilling; the plugging that followed explains why campaign 1 runs on to 2008-12-11, with an EZSV set on 2008-12-05, a casing cut on 2008-12-07 and a cement plug on 2008-12-08.
Section 0 holds 0.25 h of moving activity before the first stated section and reports no hole size.
Section 1 is a 36.0 in section drilled from 2007-11-19 to 2007-12-22, from 144.2 m to 226.0 m MD (TVD 226.0 m), with 226.0 m of new hole and an average of 18.45 m/h while coded drilling.
The rate is an average over all time coded as drilling, not an on-bottom rate of penetration.
Section 2 is a 26.0 in section drilled from 2007-12-23 to 2007-12-30, from 226.0 m to 1378.0 m MD (TVD 1347.0 m), with 1152.0 m of new hole at an average of 20.57 m/h while coded drilling.
Section 3 is a 26.0 in section from 2008-09-06 to 2008-09-10 at 1378.0 m MD (TVD 1347.0 m); it drilled no new hole, so no rate is reported because no new hole was drilled.
Section 4 is a 26.0 in section from 2008-09-18 to 2008-09-19, from 1378.0 m to 1381.0 m MD (TVD 1349.0 m), with 3.0 m of new hole at an average of 0.71 m/h while coded drilling.
Section 5 is a 12.25 in section from 2008-09-20 to 2008-11-12, from 1381.0 m to 2536.0 m MD (TVD 2350.0 m), with 1155.0 m of new hole at an average of 10.11 m/h while coded drilling.
Section 6 is an 8.5 in section from 2008-11-13 to 2008-11-28, from 2536.0 m to 4090.0 m MD (TVD 3178.0 m), with 1554.0 m of new hole at an average of 8.42 m/h while coded drilling.
Section 7 has no reported hole size; it covers plug and abandonment from 2008-11-29 to 2018-01-24 at 4090.0 m MD (TVD 3178.0 m) with no new hole, so no rate is reported.
Section 1 starts below a casing shoe at 220.6 m MD and no casing set is reported for it.
Section 2 starts below the same shoe at 220.6 m MD and sets casing with its shoe at 1368.4 m MD.
Sections 3 and 4 start below the 1368.4 m shoe, and no casing set is reported in either.
Section 5 starts below the 1368.4 m shoe and sets casing with its shoe at 2561.8 m MD.
Section 6 starts below a shoe at 2534.0 m MD, which does not match the 2561.8 m shoe recorded for section 5; the tools do not reconcile the two values, and no casing set is reported in section 6.
Section 7 starts below the 2534.0 m shoe and sets no casing.
The tools give no casing size for any set shoe, so none is stated in this review.
Primary lost time is 74.0 h, or 5.16% of the wellbore's activity time.

By section, primary lost time is 1.25 h (0.7% of section 2 activity time), 4.5 h (4.48%) in section 3, 17.5 h (4.05%) in section 5, 50.5 h (14.08%) in section 6 and 0.25 h (0.09%) in section 7; sections 1 and 4 have no primary lost time.

By cause, primary lost time is 49.0 h of well control (section 6), 13.25 h of waiting on weather (section 5), 5.5 h of drilling wait (sections 3 and 6), 4.25 h of fishing (section 5) and 2.0 h of repair (sections 2, 6 and 7).
Possible lost time is reported separately and is not added to the primary figures: 157.0 h in total (10.94% of activity time).
By cause, possible lost time is 93.0 h of other interruptions, 49.25 h of maintenance, 14.0 h of plug-and-abandon waiting and 0.75 h of waiting.
Possible time is concentrated in section 5 (71.5 h, 16.56% of its activity time), section 7 (62.5 h, 22.4%) and section 4 (7.0 h, 26.42%).
On 2008-09-20 the drill string came apart under a drilling pup joint in section 5 and fell to bottom; fishing and recovery took 4.25 h of primary lost time.
Troubleshooting of the ZMS and VICIS control system started on 2008-09-20, and one stretch of 10.25 h on 2008-09-21 was logged as possible lost time.
On 2008-10-03 and 2008-10-04 high wind stopped crane lifts of casing equipment, giving 5.75 h of primary weather waiting in section 5.
On 2008-11-11 derrick inspection and repairs during a weather wait took 7.5 h of primary lost time.
From 2008-11-14, circulation losses while drilling section 6 required repeated LCM pills and staged flow tests, and the section carried 49.0 h of primary well-control time.
On 2008-11-22 a BX elevator latching failure needed repair, costing 0.5 h of primary time.
On 2008-11-29 the PS-21 slips could not hold drill pipe during the trip out after total depth, costing 0.25 h of primary time.
On 2008-11-29 a trip-tank gain was flow-checked, the well was shut in on the upper pipe ram with no pressure build-up, and rain water was entering the mud.

On 2008-12-01 a drill pipe tipped off an HTS roller post onto the cantilever when the rollers did not stop on command; no personnel were in the area, and the incident was logged as possible lost time of 0.25 h.
Check the make-up of drill pipe and pup joints before running the 12.25 in section, because the string separation on 2008-09-20 ended in 4.25 h of fishing.

Plan loss control before the 8.5 in section: the 49.0 h of well-control time in section 6 came from losses handled reactively with LCM pills, so the next well should pre-plan LCM and a loss-response procedure for the formations expected to take fluid.
Schedule casing and crane work around weather: the wellbore logged 13.25 h of primary weather waiting in section 5, including 5.75 h of crane waits on 2008-10-03 and 2008-10-04.
Follow up the control-system faults: 93.0 h of possible other-interruption time, including a 10.25 h stretch of ZMS and VICIS troubleshooting, should be reviewed before the next well spuds.

Plan plug-and-abandonment logistics: section 7 carried 62.5 h of possible time, 22.4% of its activity time, mostly waiting, so cement, tools and crane slots should be staged before the plugging starts.

Fix the record-keeping: 36 reports are flagged as dated before spud, the casing shoe is 2534.0 m at the start of section 6 but 2561.8 m for section 5, and the section 7 hole size is not reported; the next well should record the casing shoe and hole size consistently.

row.comments: Attempted to work string free. Not able to come down - string at TD. Attempted to come up - functioned jar twice. Attempted to work string free by applying torque up to 40 kNm and overpull of 40 MT. Made way from 1381 m to 1376 m MD. Attempted to pump - hole still packed off. Bled off 27 bar pressure trapped on standpipe and heard loud roarring sound. Lost string weight - went to just above block weight. POOH with 5 1/2" DP and found string screwed out underneath 6 m drilling pup joint. Laid out pup joint - found no damage on threads.
Troubleshot problems with ZMS / control system.

WOW. Wind speed too high for crane to operate. Could not get casing hanger/PADPRT assy and HWDP landing string.

Meanwhile broke circulation at 2384 m. Staged up pumps slowly to 1000 lpm / 30 bar. Reciprocated pipe from 2374 m to 2383 m.

WOW. Wind speed too high for crane to operate. Could not lift csg tong onto drill floor or LO hanger/PADPRT assy.

Meanwhile MU TDS and broke circulation carefully. Increased flowrate in steps of 200 lpm up to 2000 lpm / 30 bar. Broke out TDS and PU single HWDP to be able to reciprocate without have csg hanger/PADPRT assembly in BOP. Circulated and reciprocated csg from 2412 m to 2406 m, 1000 lpm / 10 bar.

WOW for derrick inspection using CAN climbers. Had 35-40 knots wind.

Meanwhile started slew calibrating PRS.

WOW for derrick inspection. 

Meanwhile changed out bumper bar on aft PRS using parts from fwd PRS. Fixed broken electrical connection on aft PRS. Removed scaffolding from rig floor. Injected slop into F-14. Performed remaining pressure test on kill and choke manifolds. Modified hooks for lifting bridle. Changed o-rings on leaking coomey unit. Installed flush joint elevator on PRS and function tested same.

Staged up pumps to establish loss free rate. Meanwhile continued adding LCM chemicals to active and prepared 150 kg/m3 LCM pill in pit according contingency plan. Monitored losses while pumping and reciprocating pipe, Flow 440 lpm / SPP 25 bar / String RPM 10 / TQ 9-10 kNm. Average loss rate 1000 ltrs/hr.
Changed out BX elevators due to latching problem, back up set would not work, installed original elevator & investigated problem with latch.
PS-21 slips unable to hold DP. Investigated problem.
Flow checked well on trip tank, 670l gain in 7 minutes.

HTS rollers failed to stop. As running HTS and Rollers in manual. Rollers did not stop after command. This caused 3½" DP to tip off the last Roller post. The DP end landed on the Cantilever. No personnel in area due to area had been barried prior to commencing operation. Installed FOSV and monitored on trip tank.

Set EZSV at 1437 m MD by applying 35 righthand rotations / torque 2-4 kNm. Picked up weight and sheared setting sleeve with 26 MT overpull. Picked up 3 m above plug and ran back in to 1437 m MD and tagged plug with 10 MT set down - ok.

Filled pipe pumping at 500 lpm. Obtained pump benchmark for cutting casing 500 lpm / SPP 59 bar, stopped pumps. Started rotation with 120 rpm. Started circulation at 500 lpm. Observer torque bulidingup to 5-11 kNm indicating effective cutting. Noticed small shock in derrick after 2,5 min of cutting indicating successful cut. Stopped rotation. Increased pump rate to 900 lpm / 55 bar - good indication. Picked up 2,5 m above cut. Came down while pumping at 400 lpm, observed sudden pressure drop as prescribed when passing cut at 1422 m MD. Stopped pumping. Marked pipe and tagged top of cut casing 0,25 m below (cut gap).
Pumped 22,9 m3 2,0 sg cement at 800 lpm. After 14 m3 pumped, picked up 1 m to 1433 m MD. Chased cement slurry to drillfloor with 890 liters of water. Theoretical top of cement at 1318 m MD.
